compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a categorized list of popular content under three main tabs: SMS, Jokes, and Videos. The current tab selected is "SMS," highlighted in red. Below the tab bar, there is a list of SMS categories along with the number of items in each category. The categories and their respective item counts are:

1. Wise Words - 880
2. Marriage - 813
3. News and Politics - 795
4. Bollywood - 357
5. Cricket - 180
6. Education - 124
7. Facebook Status - 36
8. Gurbani - 54

At the bottom of the screen, there is an advertisement banner promoting the Google Play Store with a "SHOP NOW" button. The top of the screen shows the status bar with various icons and the time, which is 8:22.
